question: **What was the result of having no lockdown in Sweden? **

options.text: Sweden has achieved herd immunity against corona virus.
The economy in Sweden flourished more than before.
Sweden’s mortality rate became the highest in Europe.
Sweden’s public health care system became more robust.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Sweden’s mortality rate became the highest in Europe.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is said in the given passage, "*At first, Sweden experienced Covid-19 death rates that were comparable to those of other European countries__ that had shut down their economies*."
 
• It is also mentioned that, **The highest mortality rate in Europe is found in Sweden.**
 
• So it is clear that **as a result of having no lockdown, The highest mortality rate in all of Europe was reached in Sweden.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**
